title: SWE-Spot: Building Small Repo-Experts with Repository-Centric Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.21649v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The deployment of coding agents in privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained environments drives the demand for capable open-weight Small Language Models (SLMs). However, they suffer from a fundamental capability gap: unlike frontier large models, they lack the inference-time strong generalization to handle complicated, unfamiliar codebases. We identify that the prevailing Task-Centric Learning (TCL) approach, which scales exposure across disparate repositories, fails to address this limitation. In response, we propose Repository-Centric Learning (RCL), a shift that prioritizes vertical, single-repository depth over horizontal, single-task breadth for SLM training. To accomplish this depth, we design a four-unit Repository-Centric Experience, transforming static codebases into interactive learning signals, to train SWE-Spot-4B, a family of highly compact models built as repo-specialized experts. translated_title: SWE-Spot：通过仓库中心化学习构建小型仓库专家模型
translated_abstract: 在隐私敏感和资源受限环境中部署编码智能体的需求，推动了对高性能开源权重小型语言模型（SLM）的需求。然而，这些模型存在根本性的能力差距：与前沿大模型不同，它们缺乏在推理时应对复杂、陌生代码库的强泛化能力。我们发现当前流行的任务中心学习（TCL）方法——即在不同仓库间扩大任务暴露规模——无法解决这一局限。为此，我们提出仓库中心化学习（RCL），这是一种范式转变：在SLM训练中优先追求纵向的单仓库深度，而非横向的单任务广度。为实现这种深度，我们设计了由四个单元组成的仓库中心化经验，将静态代码库转化为交互式学习信号，用于训练SWE-Spot-4B——一系列作为仓库专门专家构建的高度紧凑模型。在受控对比实验中……
tldr: 本文提出仓库中心化学习（RCL）新范式，将静态代码库转化为交互式学习信号，训练出针对特定代码仓库深度专门化的小型语言模型SWE-Spot-4B，以弥补小型模型处理复杂陌生代码库时泛化能力不足的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Repository-Centric Learning (RCL), a paradigm that transforms static codebases into interactive learning signals to train repo-specialized compact models (SWE-Spot-4B), addressing the fundamental capability gap of small language models in handling complex, unfamiliar codebases.
